I suppose most folks aren't up for reading some a detailed and lengthy plot, effectively a mid-length novel. They are really are missing out; I think what you've written here is unquestionably one of the greatest creations on the site. The take on the CI is particularly well done.

I'm reading it years after its creation, and find myself hoping you've gone on to become an actual, publishing author. You certainly.write well enough for it. Looking forward to seeing.how this ends.
